project_type: PHP native web application (no framework) with inline JavaScript
build_system: Apache with .htaccess rewrite, no build step required
test_framework: No automated tests - manual verification via PHP syntax check
verification_instructions: 1) Run php -l on modified files to check syntax. 2) Review logic correctness by reading the code.
setup_instructions: 1) Create dev branch from main. 2) All changes go to dev branch.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external downloads. PHP 8.4 available. No database access for runtime testing. Verification limited to syntax checks and code review.
contribution_requirements: Work on dev branch. Do not modify main branch. All API endpoints use POST with type field as dispatcher.
key_patterns: API pattern: POST /api/?request=kolek with body {type:'migrasi bucket'} dispatched in routes/kolek.php. Controllers use PDO. Frontend pages are self-contained PHP+JS files. Filter pattern: kode_kantor null means konsolidasi (all branches). Response format: {status, message, data}. DPD buckets: A(0), B(1-30)=SC, C(31-60) through G(151-180)=FE, H(181-210) through N(>360)=BE. status_tag field in ref_dpd_bucket categorizes buckets.
directory_structure: monbis/ root with api/ (controllers, routes, helpers, config) and pages/ (self-contained PHP+JS views). Key controller: KolekController.php with migrasiBucketOsc (line ~900) and getMigrasiBucketDetail (line ~1244).
